title: Question 1.4: Conditional Logic in Data Transformation
instruction: This code uses conditional logic to make decisions based on data values. Think about how you might check a condition and assign a value.
reveal: This is a conditional expression that works like an if-else statement. It checks if the "sentiment" column equals "positive", and if so, returns 1. Otherwise, it returns 0. This is similar to `if (sentiment.equals("positive")) { return 1; } else { return 0; }` but written in a more compact, functional style that works with data transformations.
